newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares rises, further modest gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares rises, further modest gains seen.

text.p: Danish share prices rose in early trade on Tuesday but dealers expected further gains to be limited and trade thin, with the summer holiday season now in full swing.
"We expect a little rise today of about 0.25 percent. There may still be a few ripples around Carlsberg and Danisco, but otherwise we don't expect great movement," a dealer said.
At 0825 GMT the KFX top-20 index was up 0.60 point to 172.31, a 0.35 percent gain.
Carlsberg settled back to 365 crowns after rising 10 crowns to 366.00 on Friday.
Danisco continued to recover from last week's falls, rising five crowns to 411.00 on Tuesday morning.
